177:t_1:329.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's not just me. $$ティファ$$ and $$パーラ$$ are with me, too.」

177:t_1:330.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Could you be... the pilot of that Gundam with the whiskers on its cheeks...?」

177:t_1:331.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's $$ガンダムＤＸ$$. I'm its pilot, $$ガロード・ラン$$.」

177:t_1:332.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And these two are my friends, $$ティファ・アディール$$ and $$パーラ・シス$$.」

177:t_1:334.en:
$$パーラ$$
「I'm the pilot of the $$Ｇファルコン$$, and I back up $$ガロード$$'s $$ダブルエックス$$.」

177:t_1:335.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ガロード$$ and the others fought alongside us in the $$ＵＣＷ$$ as $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, and in the $$ＡＤＷ$$ as $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

177:t_1:336.en:
$$シン$$
「Aren't $$ジャミル$$, $$ウィッツ$$, $$ロアビィ$$ and the rest with you?」

177:t_1:337.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We got separated from those guys in the so-called $$新世時空震動$$, and we still haven't found them.」

177:t_1:338.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Knowing that bunch, I'm sure they're safe, though.」

177:t_1:339.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The $$新世時空震動$$ threw us into the $$残されの海$$, where the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ picked us up, and we've been doing odd jobs.」

177:t_1:340.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What's this $$ガルガンティア船団$$ you mentioned?」

177:t_1:341.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$翠の地球$$ is basically based on the $$ＵＣＷ$$, apparently, but it seems several other worlds have merged into it, too...」

177:t_1:342.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$残されの海$$ is one of them. Apparently the people there form fleets and live out on the sea.」

177:t_1:343.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「The $$ガルガンティア船団$$ is one of those fleets, see.」

177:t_1:344.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$c helped us when pirates were attacking us.」

177:t_1:345.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you two from that fleet, by any chance...?」

177:t_1:346.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yes! I'm $$エイミー$$. Nice to meet you!」

177:t_1:347.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'm $$ピニオン$$... a repairman. Well, nice to meet you.」

177:t_1:349.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, hey... You aren't looking down on us as a bunch of hicks, are you?」

177:t_1:351.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Knock it off, $$ピニオン$$. You're scaring $$ティファ$$.」

177:t_1:353.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Sorry, $$ティファ$$. You've got to start strong so nobody takes you for a pushover.」

177:t_1:354.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Honestly...! What are you going to do if people think everyone in the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ is like that?!」

177:t_1:355.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$残されの海$$ became part of $$翠の地球$$ through the $$新世時空震動$$, but because they live at sea, they had little contact with other civilizations.」

177:t_1:356.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Well... long story short, we're a little behind you folks when it comes to machine technology.」

177:t_1:357.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「But I plan to learn all that in $c, and improve my skills as a repairman and as a man.」

177:t_1:358.en:
$$シン$$
「Behind in machine technology...? Then what's that black robot?」

177:t_1:359.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That person near it... is from the $$ガルガンティア船団$$, right?」

177:t_1:360.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That machine's name is $$チェインバー#robot$$... That one's a little special.」

177:t_1:361.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$! I'm going to introduce you to everyone, so come over here!」

177:t_1:364.en:
$$バナージ$$
($c... do people like that just tend to gather there?)

177:t_1:365.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can hear you, $$シン$$, $$バナージ$$.」

177:t_1:367.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm looking after $$レド$$. I will not tolerate careless words or behavior.」

177:t_1:368.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(So $$宗介$$ is starting to hate being called a brooding type, just like $n...)

177:t_1:369.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So, Sergeant... why don't you hurry up and introduce your Ensign here to everyone?」

177:t_1:373.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Inferred to be a rite of passage in which one states one's name and affiliation, and shows a group that one has no hostile intent.」

177:t_1:375.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. This unit will demonstrate a model self-introduction.」

177:t_1:376.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is Airframe No. K6821, $$チェインバー#robot$$. It is equipped with a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface.」

177:t_1:377.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Interface... So the one talking is that AI...」

177:t_1:378.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Okay, now it's $$レド$$'s turn.」

177:t_1:379.en:
$$レド$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, assigned to the 《$$人類銀河同盟$$》.」

177:t_1:380.en:
$$シン$$
「$$人類銀河同盟$$...? You're not from the $$ガルガンティア船団$$?」

177:t_1:381.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$レド$$ and the tin can were sunk in the $$残されの海$$ until we salvaged them just the other day.」

177:t_1:382.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit's name is $$チェインバー#robot$$. This unit rejects the designation 'tin can'.」

177:t_1:383.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're so stiff. That's exactly why I want to call you a tin can.」

177:t_1:384.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ had its sphere of activity in the galactic core, and was fighting monsters called 《$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$》, I hear.」

177:t_1:385.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$レド$$ got caught up in a $$時空震動|lc$$ and came to Earth, but that Alliance is a little unusual from our point of view...」

177:t_1:386.en:
$$宗介$$
「Fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is their one absolute value, and people who are useless in combat supposedly aren't permitted to exist.」

177:t_1:389.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's enough, $$バナージ$$. In the multiverse, we're also expected to accept values different from our own.」

177:t_1:390.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Look who's talking, when you had such a hard time fitting in at school...」

177:t_1:391.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$ was confused by fleet life at first too, but you learned the language and got used to it just fine, didn't you?」

177:t_1:395.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I see... So he only looked like a brooding type because he wasn't used to life on Earth yet.」

177:t_1:396.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do not use the word 'brooding', $$カミーユ$$.」

177:t_1:398.en:
$$シン$$
「But you finally got used to life in the fleet. Why did you join $c?」

177:t_1:399.en:
$$レド$$
「...To fight the $$サイデリアル$$.」

177:t_1:401.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$, where $$レド$$ belonged, was apparently fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ too.」

177:t_1:402.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That is a fact. Their sphere of influence is vast, and armed clashes with the Alliance occur frequently.」

177:t_1:403.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you're trying to carry out that mission on Earth, too...」

177:t_1:404.en:
$$レド$$
「That is not the only reason.」

177:t_1:405.en:
$$レド$$
「After I came to Earth, I met $$エイミー$$ and the others and learned many things.」

177:t_1:406.en:
$$レド$$
「And I learned that the world is much bigger. So I... wanted to learn more of it.」

177:t_1:407.en:
$$エイミー$$
「And $$ピニオン$$ and I came along, too.」

177:t_1:408.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「That's right. Take care of us, tin can included.」

uncertain: 177:t_1:347 and 408: Pinion's 'yoroshiku tanomu' rendered as a greeting 'nice to meet you' (347) and 'Take care of us, tin can included' (408).
177:t_1:388: Banagher's 'sonna no tte...' (trailing) rendered 'That's not right...'.
177:t_1:345: 'you two' assumed to be Amy and Pinion.
177:t_1:359/360: Banagher's 'person near that robot' kept gender-neutral; Garrod's 'aitsu' for Chamber rendered 'That one'.
Brooding type = mutsuri (matches dlg_2009_01 / 2010_03); tin can = burikiyaro (matches 2010_02/03).
Chamber rows use the #pilot speaker token (as in 2009-2010); name inside speech uses #robot token.
Airframe No. K6821 for the unit number; 'Alliance' alone used in 385 and 402.
